lots.title: VAN DIEMEN - ADVENTURE BAY MAP
lots.reason: Genuine 18th century Tasmanian map is collectable; worth inspecting
lots.findings: Framed hand-coloured copper engraving 'Carte de la Terre Van-Diemen' with inset 'Plan de la Baie de l'Aventure'. Imprint 'Par M. Bonne, Ingenieur-Hydrographe de la Marine' (Rigobert Bonne) and small engraver credit bottom right (Andre sculp?). Title says Adventure Bay Van Diemen's Land, late 1780s Encyclopedie Methodique / Atlas style. Plate lines and hand colour consistent with an original 18th century map, not a modern print.
lots.condition: Paper looks clean, toned slightly; under glass, burr frame. Folds or foxing not visible
lots.rescore_note: Bonne Van Diemen map with Adventure Bay inset, likely genuine 1780s engraving, typically $120-300 framed, discounted for unverified originality.
